svg.title: Frontier Scout: did this agent PR stay inside the scope declared on its base branch?
svg.desc: frontier-scout · PR scope verifier · policy compiler. Did this agent PR stay inside the scope declared on its base branch? One typed policy compiles into Claude Code controls; CI checks every PR diff against it. Anything unproven is never a pass. Evidence card, verify-pr - POLICY AND LOCK READ FROM THE BASE COMMIT: path outside allowed_file_globs → FAIL (exit 1); protected path, unsigned receipt only → UNVERIFIED (exit 1); change within declared scope → PASS (exit 0). Sources: examples/demo-walkthrough.md; this repo runs the Action on its own PRs (advisory).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
